annotations.title: Finalise a quote and get the customer link

description: Lock a draft so the customer can answer it. Sets today's date and the valid-until date, and returns the customer link, the PDF link and a short ready-to-send message. Nothing is sent by this server: the trade sends the link by their own text, WhatsApp or email. Free allowance: 5 finalised quotes per calendar month (UK time) per trade, shown as free_allowance in the answer and in get_trade; past it the quote stays a saved draft and can be finalised from the 1st of next month. Drafts, revisions of quotes already sent, replies and exports never count.

trade_key.description: The trade's secret key from setup_trade (starts qbk_).
